'''Strategists''' were specialists within the ranks of military forces who were responsible for formulating the overall strategy of a war, rather than focusing on individual battles and campaigns. Both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] made use of strategists.

==Description==
Strategists were employed by military forces, including the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="LBE" /> and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="EGVV" /> to formulate and plan overall strategy during military campaigns and wars. They did not focus on individual battles, but rather the bigger picture, analyzing past events and using that data to see what could occur if they implemented their strategies. Strategists also oversaw other elements of the military, including logistical planning to ensure that military units were properly equipped and not spread to thinly.<ref name="LBE" />

Strategists were detail-oriented and level-headed, although they were rarely in direct command of military forces. They possessed a great deal of knowledge on the art and history of warfare, being aware of not only the capabilities and weaknesses of their own forces, but of the enemy as well.<ref name="LBE" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] strategists privately admitted that the Navy feared buying [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] equipped with [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] as it would be seen as an excuse to cut orders for new [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. This was part of the reason that the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] was not ordered in large quantities, with excessive cost being cited as the official reason.<ref name="EGVV" />

[[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] served as a civilian strategist advising the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] prior to joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CCG-Rieekan">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=General Carlist Rieekan}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tanbris/Legends|Tanbris]] was an Imperial strategist aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]. He specialized in the direction of Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="CCG-Tanbris">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Lieutenant Tanbris}}</ref>
